verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll exposes a full REST API with idempotency keys, pagination, webhooks, and demo/sandbox environments, which could be scripted headlessly/in CI by a partner integration; however there is no evidence of a CLI, SDK automation for pipelines, or any explicit CI/headless-run documentation — the MCP server (gusto-docs-6/34) is for AI coding assistants in dev editors, not for headless CI execution. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless execution docs, official CLI or automation SDK, evidence of scheduled/unattended API-driven payroll runs.
